ImportantPolicies.Title: Attendance Policy
ImportantPolicies.Body: Ensure daily attendance is reviewed before payroll cut-off. Missing punches must be resolved the same day.

ImportantPolicies.Title: Leave Approval
ImportantPolicies.Body: All leave requests require approval before the start date. Emergency leave must be documented.

ImportantPolicies.Title: Overtime Policy
ImportantPolicies.Body: Overtime is payable only for approved requests. Review multipliers and approval levels regularly.

ImportantPolicies.Title: Security
ImportantPolicies.Body: Do not share credentials. Enable role-based access and audit critical actions.
